accountContext.note: Equity is based on local state/log records. The imported Bybit CSV is order history, so it verifies fills and fees but not full account-equity history.

csv.reason: The imported Bybit order-history CSV has no funding columns. Funding must be imported from Bybit funding/transaction history for exact funding accounting.

funding.reason: No funding fields were present in the imported Bybit order-history CSV. Local records mostly store actualFundingUsdt as zero when available.

notes: The CSV is order history, not Bybit closed-PnL history.
Completed trades are reconstructed from filled orders with FIFO accounting.
Funding is unavailable unless a separate funding/transaction export is imported.

assumptions: Bybit order-history CSV does not include explicit realized PnL, reduce-only, or funding fields.
Exchange completed trades were reconstructed FIFO from signed Long/Short fills.
Local bot records contain richer strategy/setup metadata; CSV records are treated as the fee and fill-price source of truth when present.

tpTooSmallEvidence.evidence: Gross-positive/net-negative trades and fee ratio indicate many moves were too small after costs. Exact TP-vs-stop effectiveness is limited by missing per-order CSV/funding data.

oversizingEvidence.latestOpenRiskUnavailable: Historical equity-at-entry was not consistently stored. V4 should record maxLossAtStopUsdt and riskPctOfEquity for every future trade.

evidence: Fee drag remains material relative to gross profit.
Profit factor after costs is still below 1 on available records.
Some trades with positive projected edge still closed net-negative, so the edge model needs calibration against actual fills.
edgeThresholdAssessment.recommendation: Do not loosen V4 edge thresholds from this audit alone. Validate in demo or very small controlled live mode and calibrate projected edge against actual net results.

topMessages.message: Adaptive pacing engaged; execution quality improved without disabling continuous execution.
Smart pacing engaged; low-quality fee bleed is being filtered while activity stays enabled.
Continuous learning preserved; recovery adjusts sizing without pausing execution.
Focused BTC/ETH/SOL active market universe prepared.
No setup reached the minimum signal score this cycle.
Using cached BTC/ETH market regime for faster scanning.
Exploration expansion active; adaptive participation increased.
Cautious mode participation enabled; risk is moderated but learning participation remains active.
Market regime evaluated from BTC and ETH.

measuredPrimaryLossDrivers: Net profit factor after costs is below 1.
Fees consumed more than half of gross profit.
Some trades were gross-positive but net-negative after costs.
Many trades closed inside 45 seconds, making fee coverage harder.
Rapid same-symbol long/short flips were detected.
conclusions.csvLimitation: Imported CSV provides filled orders and fees, but not explicit realized PnL/funding/reduce-only fields. Round trips are reconstructed from signed fills.
